title: glyph3d mapper cell picking
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkGlyph3DMapper with hardware cell picking and masking.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → selection → interaction → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkBitArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBitArray.html) — bit array.
- [vtkElevationFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkElevationFilter.html) — generates scalar data based on elevation (distance along a direction).
- [vtkGlyph3DMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGlyph3DMapper.html) — glyph3d mapper.
- [vtkHardwareSelector](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkHardwareSelector.html) — hardware selector.
- [vtkInteractorStyleRubberBandPick](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkInteractorStyleRubberBandPick.html) — interactor style rubber band pick.
- [vtkPlaneSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlaneSource.html) — generates a rectangular plane.
- [vtkRenderedAreaPicker](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderedAreaPicker.html) — rendered area picker.
- [vtkSphereSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphereSource.html) — generates a tessellated sphere.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
